**C.** Secretary of State John Hay's Open Door notes (1899–1900) asked the imperial powers to keep China open to all nations on equal commercial terms, and they aimed to preserve China's territorial integrity against partition. The team note's options don't fit: B describes the partition the notes were meant to prevent, and A and D have no basis in them. C's mention of missionaries is loose, since the notes concerned trade access.
CONFIDENCE: 90
